I'd merge this. I found no problems that need fixing, and none of the repo's checks fail.

**What I checked:**
- `pnpm vitest run packages/tailwindcss` passes: 42 test files, 5017 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- `npx prettier --check` on every changed `.ts` file and `CHANGELOG.md` reports "All matched files use Prettier code style!".
- Probing the built utilities (the probe file was deleted afterwards, and `git status` is unchanged):
  - `anchor-tooltip` gives `anchor-name: --tooltip`, `anchor-none` gives `none`, and `anchor-[--a,--b]` passes through unchanged.
  - `anchored-menu` gives `position-anchor: --menu`, `anchored-auto` gives `auto`, and `anchored-[--menu]` passes through.
  - Bare `anchor` and `anchored`, the negative forms (`-anchor-none`, `-anchored-auto`) and modified forms (`anchor-none/50`, `anchored-auto/[x]`, `anchor-foo/bar`) all produce no CSS.
- `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto` were added to the `getClassList` snapshot, so they show up in IntelliSense.
- The new properties were added to `property-order.ts`, and there's an entry under Unreleased → Added in the changelog.
- The diff touches nothing outside the issue's scope.

**Edge cases that behave reasonably:**
- `anchor--foo` gives `---foo`, which is still a valid dashed ident.
- `anchor-(--x)` gives `var(--x)`.
- `anchor-auto` gives `--auto` and `anchored-none` gives `--none`. The issue only reserves `none` for `anchor-*` and `auto` for `anchored-*`, so names are passed through as written. The tests check this.

**Nits:**
- The changelog entry has no PR link, unlike every other entry, which ends with `([#NNNNN](...))`. Add it once the PR number exists.
- `anchor-[length:1px]` gives `anchor-name: 1px`. Arbitrary values with a type hint aren't validated, but other `functionalUtility` users behave the same way.
